build_pipeline_inference: build a transformers pipeline for text classification inference with a pre-trained model on CPU or GPU
create_pipeline_batch_processing: create a pipeline that processes a dataset with batching and multiple workers for efficient inference
run_pipeline_save_load: run a pipeline and save it to disk with model, tokenizer, and processor using save_pretrained
test_pipeline_device_placement: test the pipeline device placement context manager for allocating tensors on CUDA, XPU, or HPU devices
review_pipeline_registry: review the PipelineRegistry class that registers, validates, and manages supported NLP task pipelines
